message: Deprecate tail-window turn paging (`SubscribeView.turns`, `ChatState.turnsNextCursor`, `fetchTurns`, and `chat/turnsLoaded`, now stability 3 / Legacy) in favour of deferred turns; it remains supported for 1.x clients that do not declare `deferredTurns`.
details: Read more in [Chat Channel — Legacy tail-window paging](https://microsoft.github.io/agent-host-protocol/specification/chat-channel#legacy-tail-window-paging).
